task: league-schedule-generator (flagship row 4): divisions drawn by location

deviations.why: The row's buildable items are three hard combinatorial searches (12-team carry-over below 132, bowling 26x38, 47/49 on 8x9) with no user-visible gain; the row says to judge their worth first. A missing product feature (geographic division assignment, a real pre-season need competitors leave to hand) was judged worth more.
deviations.did: Built regions.mjs + divisions-by-location.html instead of a buildable search item.
deviations.result: Feature shipped, checked exhaustively on 60 small leagues and both NFL conferences; NFL post written.

goal: Ship a user-facing feature for regional leagues: split teams into even divisions by location with the least rival travel.
notes: Verification: node --test regions.test.mjs 13/13; search equals exhaustive optimum on 60 random 8-12 team leagues and 15 keep-apart cases; NFL conferences exhaustive (2,627,625 splits each) equal to search in 64/64 starts; 32-team split 28,018 km best found (89/400 starts), branch-and-bound proof did not finish in 10 min (stated as not proved). Page driven in Playwright at 390px: example builds, no console errors, no horizontal scroll, the multi-division hand-off fills the divisions box. Data: GeoNames via geonamescache 3.0.2 wheel from PyPI (CC BY 4.0); wikidata/wikipedia/census/geonames hosts refused by proxy. Full venture suite and venture-preflight run locally (see PR).
